concept_options.title: What If You Lived a Year Every Night?
concept_options.why_this_works: The topic title (f-year-every-night, Fable's pitch, 77/100 blind); the writer's pick; pairs with thumbnail a (SAME DAY?)
concept_options.visual_approach: Seven in the morning in a dark hall of sleep pods, two tiers of hatches with warm porthole lamps behind (no lettering): you large at the left, sitting half out of your open pod (door swung up, a reading lamp, a pillow), lids heavy, a long flat stare at your flatmate; on the pod frame the crimson split-flap day counter has stopped on 365; your flatmate right of centre, lilac head, apron, mop in hand, still mid-sentence. Three candidates a, b, c differ only in the tag (SAME DAY?, ONE SLEEP., YESTERDAY?); drawn in code, brand/thumbs/yearnight
concept_options.hook: The pod hall after close: your boss unpacks a cable ("Staff first."), your flatmate starts a story, you say "tell me tomorrow", climb into a pod and plug in; the hatch counter flutters to 365; you climb out a year older in your head while she finishes her sentence.

selected_concept.rationale: Writer's recommendation; the owner picks at G1. Title A with thumbnail a ("SAME DAY?"): the proven title form, and the tag plus the 365 tile is the whole rule in a half-second read.

stages.approach: Packaging (G1, 2026-11-13): three titles, three one-variable thumbnails drawn in code (brand/thumbs/yearnight), the beat outline on the template spine with a performed skit opening and six scenes where the narrator stops; claims.md (c01-c30) sourced at G1; the G1 room (story editor, claims check)

script.md, sequel.md and 6-8 chapters on the template (rules/story.md #1-#19, 155 wpm, about 9.5 min), the room's G1 story notes applied; free local narration with per-character local voices and a 720p first cut before G2, a cue per section and an ambience bed per set; the G2 room; omni qc story_script must pass
Picture lock: cut, key shot (staged exactly as the thumbnail), text, music and mix; the local voice ships unless the owner asks for the paid A/B
The owner watches at 1x with cold viewers
Private upload only, by the owner's exact instruction; the public flip by hand in YouTube Studio

line_items.notes: Free and local. The paid voice only if the owner asks for the A/B, quoted first. G1 made no paid call: the thumbnails are drawn in code; the room used today's capped calls (story editor, claims check)
